ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area estimated at 90-95%, with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters accounting for the remaining 5-10%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous black base intensity across both lobes; high-contrast white geometric primitives (annular rings and linear segments) are distributed asymmetrically across the fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, wide U-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 140 degrees and a vertical depth relative to the lobe apexes of roughly 12% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, multi-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; distal regions show larger jagged peaks (10-20 pixels) while proximal regions near the notch show lower-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-curved sigmoidal trajectory; exhibiting concavity originating at the median notch and transitioning to a broad convexity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast white annular rings (diameters 5-15 pixels) scattered across both lobes, with higher density clusters near the trailing edges and distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned, high-intensity linear pixel streaks (1-3 pixels in width); most prominent are vertical scratches on the lower right lobe and diagonal marks on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of high-intensity, textured calcified clusters (barnacles) visible on the extreme distal tips and the lower leading edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent high-intensity scar/lesion cluster visible at the base of the fluke near the water-line interface.
